follow-up time: Until the third month of life
outcome: Incidence of Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH)
Rate of immature (not yet fully developed) hips
cohort: 300 infants followed by the "Child Health Follow-up Outpatient Clinic" between December 2014 and May 2015.
finding: The incidence of DDH was 0.3%, while 16.7% had immature hips; immature hips were significantly associated with positive family history of DDH, swaddling, and left hip involvement, and 98% of immature hips resolved by the third month of life.
mod_finding: Swaddling was significantly associated with immature hips.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a risk factor, but specific values not provided.
